fischlins_transformation-cryp.derivation: Game (archive.cryptohack.org:3583, chal.py): 64 rounds; each round leaks w0 (input '0'), prover runs Fischlin-OR proof with hidden b, must guess b (16 attempts/round, guess applies to last attempt). WI break: replay the b=0-hypothesis RO-search path from the leak. Under b=0, side 0 is real: e_sim = e1, r_b = (z0 - e0*w0) mod q, and a0,a1,z1 are constant across the prover's e-loop, so for every e' <= e_cur I recompute e0' = e'^e1, z0' = r_b + e0'*w0 mod q and RO(a0,a1,e',e0',e1,z0',z1) < 2^506 check. If the replay reproduces the server's path exactly (no hit for e'<e_cur AND hit at e_cur) it is consistent with b=0 (soft evidence, posterior error (63/64)^(e_cur+1)); any deviation (hit below e_cur or miss at e_cur) is a CERTAIN b=1 signal since the b=0 replay would have matched perfectly. Optimal-stopping DP over 16 attempts (e ~ Geom(1/64)) gives per-attempt thresholds (stop-answer-0 iff e_cur >= T, T=70..367 by attempts remaining; stop-answer-1 on any inconsistency) -> 99.77% per round, ~86% per session. Client (fis_play.py) uses DP thresholds; validated vs local clone (0 false hits on 150 b=0 proofs). Sessions: live attempt 1 won 33/64 rounds (forced-attempt tail loss), attempt 2 won all 64 -> flag. Prior '20s timeout' diagnosis: NOT server-side and NOT a dead listener - live service responds in <0.3s per round (fis_diag.log full capture); the sibling client deadlocked on framing: server input() prompts are sent WITHOUT trailing newline while its recv_until required buf[-1]=='\n' AND marker, so it spun to its 20s timeout at every prompt. Raw logs: w6e/fis_diag.log, w6e/fis_live1.log, w6e/fis_live2.log (server tail verbatim: "well done, you distinguished all the witnesses!\nb'FLAG-REDACTED-SEE-FLAGS-MIRROR'").
